summary: Practise AI workflows for executive email, calendars, meetings, and follow-up. Build review checklists and a responsible-use action plan.
lede: AI-assisted admin workflows help executive assistants and office teams handle correspondence, scheduling, meetings, and follow-up with human review. Participants practise prompt design, inbox routing, calendar prioritization, meeting-summary checks, and confidentiality safeguards, using responsible-use and risk frameworks as reference points rather than certification preparation. Exercises produce reusable prompts, review checklists, routing maps, and workflow action plans for use with approved tools.
audienceIntro: This course suits administrative professionals who handle executive communication, scheduling, meeting records, and task coordination. It is designed for people who want to use AI in specific support workflows while retaining responsibility for sensitive information and final decisions.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Assistant Work
OECD AI Principles for Meeting Intelligence
NIST AI RMF Workflow Action Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with executive or office administration, such as handling correspondence, calendars, or meeting follow-up. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if you will use an approved AI assistant during exercises; access to any specific paid product is not required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
